title: Vehicle Speed Detection & Violation Enforcement

meta.title: Vehicle Speed Detection & Violation Enforcement | Foxtroit AI
meta.description: Clocks every vehicle, flags the ones breaking the limit.

blocks.title: The Problem
blocks.content: Manual speed enforcement can't scale — most violations go undetected, and the ones that are caught take time to verify and process into a penalty.

blocks.title: The Solution
blocks.content: Continuous AI monitoring clocks vehicle speed in real time, captures an image of the violator and their plate, and logs the violation automatically — no manual review step.

blocks.title: Outcome
blocks.content: Consistent enforcement with far less manual monitoring, and penalties issued without delay.
